page: OVHcloud t2-le-90 is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for compute-intensive workloads. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 6226R processor running at 2.9 GHz. The system provides 30 dedicated physical cores with single-thread execution, paired with 90.0 GB of system memory, yielding 3.0 GB of RAM per core. Graphics acceleration is delivered via two NVIDIA Volta V100S GPUs, providing a combined total of 64 GB of VRAM. Local storage consists of a 500 GB NVMe SSD, and network connectivity is supported by a 4 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark results indicate strong performance in parallelized tasks and machine learning inference. The server achieves top-tier status in LLM inference speeds across multiple model sizes, processing 17320.17 tokens per second for a small 135M model prompt and 151.96 tokens per second for a large 70B model prompt. Text generation speeds are also notable, reaching 131.54 tokens per second on a medium 7B model and 18.65 tokens per second on a 70B model. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression performs in the top 25% at 228.36 GB/sec. Standard CPU and memory benchmarks, including Geekbench and PassMark, consistently register in the average range, reflecting the balanced capabilities of the Intel Xeon processor.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the t2-le-90 offers high resource density by bundling dual enterprise-grade Volta GPUs with dedicated CPU cores and local NVMe storage. This configuration avoids the overhead of shared-core architectures, though the 3.0 GB of RAM per core represents a potential tradeoff for memory-bound applications that require larger system memory pools. The instance is highly suited for deep learning, large language model inference, parallel data processing, and GPU-accelerated scientific simulations.
